Generated Narrative: CodeSystem venous-flow-metric-cs

This case-sensitive code system https://awatson1978.github.io/aerospace-medicine-ig/CodeSystem/venous-flow-metric-cs defines the following codes:

CodeDisplayDefinition
forward-flow-time Forward Flow TimeDuration of antegrade flow within the sample window (s)
retrograde-flow-time Retrograde Flow TimeDuration of retrograde flow within the sample window (s)
zero-flow-time Zero Flow TimeDuration of stagnant flow within the sample window (s)
total-sample-time Total Sample TimeTotal duration of the Doppler sample window (s)
fdi-ratio Flow Directionality IndexFDI = ((t_forward - t_retrograde) / T_total) * (1 - t_zero / T_total)
